prompt: automake parallel make recovery locking portable test-and-set command
answer:
Use `mkdir` as the portable filesystem-level test-and-set:

```sh
trap 'rm -rf data.lock data.stamp' 1 2 13 15

if mkdir data.lock 2>/dev/null; then
    # First process: rebuild
    rm -f data.stamp
    $(MAKE) $(AM_MAKEFLAGS) data.stamp
    result=$?
    rm -rf data.lock
    exit $result
else
    # Follower processes: wait for the lock holder
    while test -d data.lock; do sleep 1; done
    test -f data.stamp
fi
```

The search results identify `mkdir data.lock 2>/dev/null` as a portable test-and-set: only the first process creates the directory; concurrent processes wait until it is removed.
